full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff-appellants instituted the aforesaid suit for declaration of their title to and confirmation of possession in the suit land on the averments, inter alia, that they became owners of the suit land by inheritance as well as by purchase from the transferees of the original owners, Hemanta Kumar, Ranginimoyee Dashya and Soudamoni Deshya, recorded in CS Khatian No.390, Mouza Kazipur, PS Gangni, Meherpur; that during SA Operation the suit land was wrongly recorded in the name of the Government and they instituted TS No.50 of 1969 for correction of record and got a decree; that in pursuance of the said decree the SA records were corrected in their names and they have been possessing the same on payment of rent; that having come to know on 28-4-85 the conspiracy of the defendants to dispossess them from the suit land they instituted a proceeding under section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and ultimately the Upazila Magistrate dismissed that case on 10-6-85 with the observation that the dispute should be resolved between the parties in the civil Court; that thereafter the defendants again conspired to cut and take away forcibly the paddy and jute grown by the plaintiffs in the suit land and they having come to know on 15-6-86 of such conspiracy of the defendants brought the aforesaid suit with a prayer for injunction.
